scope: Verified semantic notes applied alongside the immutable captured OpenAPI; no backend changes in this handoff

UpdatePaymentRequest.evidence: UpdatePaymentRequest tracks property presence; PaymentService metadata command supports omitted=retain, explicit null=clear; PaymentCommandPostgresTest covers clearing.

nullable_response_notes.rule: Both fields are always present and may be null. OAS 3.1 snapshot may express legacy nullable:true; a strict JSON Schema validator/type generator must model this as a null union. Other optional response fields must be checked against source/actual fixtures; absence of nullable annotation alone is not non-null proof.

actual_contract.ui: Disable physical delete; use pending cancellation command

operation_overrides.evidence: PaymentController keeps deprecated route; PaymentService.delete always rejects an authorized mapped actor.

operation_overrides.conditional_validation: Provider error with nonblank error may omit authorization code; success requires nonblank code and state; state/provider authentication remains a service rule.

adapter_notes: 152 operations have ENVELOPE JSON success; 22 RAW JSON, 1 binary PDF, 1 redirect/empty. Full per-operation modes in api-operation-index.md.
Current frontend apiClient already unwraps envelope success. Raw success needs explicit endpoint-specific responseMode:raw; errors still use the error adapter.
CORE PagedResponse queries are 1-based page/pageSize; payroll reconciliation uses 0-based page/size and raw Spring Page.
BillingInvoice identity is invoiceId; generic InvoiceView identity is id. Do not force every command DTO into Refine BaseRecord without an adapter.
validation_limits: Schema-valid examples do not prove a real employee, invoice eligibility/balance, provenance, hash freshness, role/membership, provider authenticity or immutable-history rules.
NotBlank and conditional/domain validation are not fully represented by generated OpenAPI required/minLength.
recordedAt must be omitted on Payment create; server generates actor/time. UpdatePaymentRequest accepts only its two metadata properties.

Normalized OIDC principal test does not verify real OIDC bearer/JWKS authentication. Current backend bearer filter uses Lark internal-token verification; frontend OIDC deployment requires explicit compatible server verification.
